title: VanillaRPG
description: A vanilla-style modpack that adds RPG features to make the game more interesting
body:
**VanillaRPG** is a Vanilla+ style modpack designed for players who love the original Minecraft feeling but want deeper gameplay, new challenges, and a stronger sense of adventure. The goal is to keep the soul of vanilla Minecraft intact — simple, recognizable, and open-ended — while expanding it with RPG-inspired systems and more world variety.

In VanillaRPG, exploration feels fresh again. Thanks to _YUNG’s Better Structures_, the world is filled with beautifully designed dungeons, towers, ruins, and other mysterious landmarks waiting to be discovered. Each journey feels unique, rewarding curious players who venture off the beaten path. Combined with _AmbientSounds_, every biome feels more alive than ever — from the rustling forests to the echoing depths of ancient caves.

Survival becomes more strategic with _NutritionZ_ and a _Thirst Bar_, requiring you to manage not just hunger but also hydration and nutrition to stay healthy and strong. The _Traveler’s Backpack_ helps you carry your loot and gear more efficiently, so you can explore longer without constant trips home.

Progression takes on a whole new meaning with _Progression Reborn_ and a full _RPG skill tree_. Level up your character, unlock powerful abilities, and specialize your playstyle to match your preferred way of surviving — whether that’s combat, mining, building, or exploration. _Advanced Netherite_ brings even more late-game depth, offering tougher materials and upgraded equipment for seasoned adventurers.

To make every world feel truly alive, _RPGDifficulty_ dynamically adjusts the danger level based on your progress and surroundings. The longer you survive and the deeper you explore, the more intense your challenges become — forcing you to adapt, grow stronger, and stay alert. Every region has its own risk and reward, creating a constant sense of tension and progression.

Altogether, VanillaRPG offers a rich, immersive experience that enhances every part of Minecraft — from early-game survival to endgame mastery — without losing the familiar vanilla charm.
